name: subprocess-tools
description: External subprocess consumer: exposes the subprocess@1 capability as the tools 'subprocess run' and 'subprocess policy' - provider agnostic, no backend named

config.description: The consumer only shapes the tools it registers; cwd, deadlines, caps, the shell policy and the spill handoff belong to the provider's row.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline the 'subprocess run' tool uses when the call names none (the provider's own default and hard cap still apply).

maxOutputBytes.description: Inline byte cap the 'subprocess run' tool uses when the call names none (the provider's own default and hard cap still apply).
